ar: وَ هَبْ لِيْ أَيَا رَبَّاهُ كَشْفًا مُقَدَّسًا
لِأَدْرِيْ بِهِ سِرَّ الْبَقَاءِ مَعَ الْفَنَا
tr: Wa hab lī Ayā Rabbāhu kashfan muqaddasā
Li adrī bi hi sirra ‘l-baqā’i ma`a ‘l-fanā
en: Bestow upon me, O Lord of a sanctified unveiling – So I reach by it the secret of remaining in annihilation.

ar: وَجُدْ لِيْ بِجَمْعِ الْجَمْعِ فَضْلًا وَمِنَّةً
وَدَاوِ بِوَصْلِ الْوَصْلِ رُوْحِيْ مِنَ الضَّنَا
tr: Wa jud lī bi jami` ‘l-jam`i faḍlan wa minnatan
Wa dāwi bi waṣli ‘l-waṣli rūḥī mina ‘ḍ-ḍanā
en: Bless me in joining the assembly with virtue and excellence – Cure by the arrival my soul of grief

ar: وَ سِرْبِيْ عَلَى النَّهْجِ الْقَوِيْمِ مُوَحِّدًا
وَ فِيْ حَضْرَةِ الْقُدْسِ الْمَنِيْعِ أَحِلَّنَا
en: Advance me through the proper trail, a Unitarian – In the Safe Holy Presence permit us

ar: بِهَا نَلْحَقُ الْأَقْوَامَ مَنْ سَارَ قَبْلَنَا ثلاثا
tr: Wa munna `alaynā Yā Wadūdu bi jadhbatin
en: Grant us, O Loving, a tug – By which we reach those traversing before us.

ar: وَ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ سَيِّدِيْ كُلَّ لَمْحَةٍ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim Sayyidī kulla lamḥatin
en: And Prayers and Salutations, my Master, in every glimpse – Upon the Chosen One, the Best of Creatures, our Prophet.
